headline: Burnley favourites at Lincoln despite one win in 11
summary: Burnley go to Sincil Bank on Saturday 22nd in the Championship with 8 points, and their manager Nicky Hayen has one win in 11 games. The Burnley Express report 15 players ruled out. Lincoln's last home game was a 0-6 defeat by West Ham, which explains why the market average still makes Burnley 41.7% favourites. But the handicap, a head start in goals, rates Burnley only 0.2 goals better, and the goals line is split at 2.5, with over at 50.8%. Burnley's best result of the run was a 4-0 win at Watford on 10 October, their only convincing away display.
read: Two struggling Championship sides meet at Sincil Bank: Burnley are 22nd with one win in 11 and a manager reported to be under pressure, while Lincoln are 18th and were beaten 0-6 at home in their last home game. The market still makes Burnley 41.7% favourites, but the handicap line of about a quarter of a goal says this is close to even, with the goals line split almost exactly at 2.5.

facts.fact: Burnley manager Nicky Hayen is reported to be expected in the dugout at Lincoln despite growing pressure, having won just one of his first 11 games in charge.
facts.meaning: A manager under pressure going to a ground where his side are expected to win — the backdrop to everything Burnley do on Saturday.

facts.fact: Lincoln lost 0-6 at home to West Ham on 14 October, with an xG of 0.39 against 3.23.
facts.meaning: The heaviest result in either team's recent run, and the clearest reason the market still rates Burnley above a team sitting higher in the table.

facts.fact: Burnley are 22nd in the Championship with 8 points from 11 games; Lincoln are 18th on 12 points.
facts.meaning: The lower-placed side is the favourite — this is a meeting of two struggling teams, not a top-versus-bottom tie.

facts.fact: Burnley are the favourites at 41.7% to win, against 31.8% for Lincoln and 26.4% for the draw.
facts.meaning: More likely than Lincoln to win, but nowhere near a certainty — roughly two chances in five.

facts.fact: Burnley's early team news for the trip lists 15 players ruled out and one fitness doubt, with captain Josh Cullen close to a return.
facts.meaning: A heavily stretched squad travelling to a ground Burnley have not visited since 1999.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line is Lincoln +0.2, with the main line at +0.25.
Burnley's one convincing result in their last five was a 4-0 win at Watford on 10 October, with an xG of 1.94 against 0.64.
facts.meaning: It is away from home that Burnley have produced their best performance of the run — relevant on a trip to Sincil Bank.

facts.fact: Lincoln lost 0-3 at Sheffield United on 10 October despite creating the better chances, 1.39 xG to 0.68.
facts.meaning: Their results have been harsher than their chance creation, which is part of why they are not bigger underdogs.

sources.fact: Burnley manager Nicky Hayen is reported to be expected in the dugout for the Lincoln match despite growing pressure, having won just one of his first 11 games.
Burnley have gone a full year without a home league win, a run extended by their defeat to Wolves.
Burnley sit in the Championship's bottom three after losing 2-1 at home to Wolves.
Burnley's early team news for the Lincoln trip lists 15 players ruled out and one fitness doubt.
Josh Laurent has urged caution over captain Josh Cullen's imminent return from injury.
Burnley's off-field mood is unsettled, with police clarifying their involvement in a confrontation over a fan banner at Turf Moor.
Lincoln go into the Burnley game looking to build on a goalless draw at Millwall and chasing a first home win.
Lincoln won their appeal against Deji Elerewe's red card from the Millwall match, making him available.
